title: Quote bhejne ke baad *"koi update?"* mat bhejo.
message:
Namaste [naam] ji, aapke [2BHK] ke quote mein ek option aur hai:
*Wardrobe laminate* se ₹[X] kam ho sakta hai, look same rahega.
Saturday ko 15 min call karein? 11 am ya 4 pm?
why: "koi update?" = pressure. *Naya option jo paise bachaye* = value. Aur call ka time fix.
caption:
Quotation ke baad client chup ho jaata hai kyunki budget upar laga, par bolna awkward hai. 🛋️

Day 3 follow-up mein:
1️⃣ Ek sasta option (same look)
2️⃣ Kitna bachega
3️⃣ 15 min call, 2 time slot

Client ko "na" nahi bolna padta, bas option chunna padta hai. Save karo 🔖

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
